ol_.name: Opening checklist
items: Turn on the hood and lights
Turn on both pizza ovens, both decks: 525 top, 525 bottom
Check and log fridge temps (Logs page)
Set up the pizza station: fill topping wells, check dates, swap anything past date
Stock sauce, cheese, and portioning tools at the pizza station
Set up sanitizer buckets and verify with test strips (Logs page)
Check the prep list and start needed prep
Set up the dish pit: dish machine on, chemicals checked
Check for deliveries, put away and rotate stock, first in first out
Put pizza sauce in the warmer
Check that brined chicken wings, tenders, and thighs are ready to go
Move chicken from the fridge to the chef base
Set up egg wash and flour for tenders
Set up trays with parchment paper
4 pizzas ready to go before doors: 2 cheese, 2 pepperoni
4 backup pans in the fridge with dough and cheese, ready to top

ml_.name: Mid shift
items: Change out all pans in the prep table
Change out water on prepped vegetables
Clean the front of the prep sink and prep table
Clean out the sinks from open

cl_.name: Closing checklist
items: Turn off both pizza ovens and brush out the decks once cooled
Cover, label, and date everything at the pizza station, leaving it in the station fridge
Filter the fryer oil (Logs page). If the oil is dark, post in the Vicio Cocina chat in Homebase
Clean and sanitize all prep surfaces and cutting boards
Sweep and mop kitchen floors, including under equipment
Run the last dish loads, then turn off and drain the dish machine
Take out trash and recycling, replace liners
Turn off the sauce warmer and put pizza sauce away
Discard egg wash and flour, clean containers
Move chicken from the chef base to the fridge
Empty sanitizer buckets and leave them to dry
Check and log fridge temps before leaving (Logs page)
Make sure all fridge doors are fully shut and sealed
Post in the Vicio Cocina chat about anything low or needing attention tomorrow
Turn off the fryer, hood, and lights on the way out

host_open.name: Host / Busser open
items: Wipe down glass doors and spot check all windows
Wipe down all tables, inside and patio
Check tall light batteries, charge if needed
Tables and chairs wiped down and arranged
Floors swept/vacuumed (patio and inside), spot check for spills or debris
Trash and recycling checked (emptied and bags replaced)
Host stand cleared and stocked (menus, pens, waitlist tools)
Service stations wiped and restocked for opening (napkins, to-go boxes, paper goods)
Restock thermal printer paper and kitchen paper (keep backup rolls on hand)
Restock silverware at all stations (wash and roll if needed)
Fill and place 2 water pitchers at Bar, 1 at Host Stand
Restock to-go boxes, paper goods, and expo supplies
Reservation/waitlist system checked for the day's bookings
Online ordering/delivery platforms checked and active (if applicable)
Cold beer stocked in the storage fridge from the backups
Napkins stocked in the expo window. Backups are in the attic
Phones away. No sitting or eating on the floor or at the bar. Slow moment? Prep, restock, or detail

host_close.name: Host / Busser close
items: Throw away trash and put in a new bag (code 0818)
Unplug marble lights and tower light
Host stand cleared and stocked (menus, pens, and waitlist tools)
Restock to-go boxes, paper goods, and expo supplies
All tables cleared, wiped, and reset or stacked per close plan
Booths/benches wiped; check for items left behind
Service stations wiped and restocked for opening (napkins, to-go boxes, paper goods)
Menus collected; pull and set aside any damaged menus
Reservation/waitlist notes squared away for next day
Toast handhelds and iPad plugged in
Bar lights and TVs/A-V powered off
Cold beer restocked in the storage fridge for tomorrow
Expo window napkins restocked from the attic backups
Women’s restroom checked: clean, trash out, toilet paper, paper towels and soap stocked
Men’s restroom checked: clean, trash out, toilet paper, paper towels and soap stocked
satOnly: Saturday: attic inventory count. Submit the Attic form (Inventory page)

bar_open.name: Bartender open
items: Toast POS terminal at bar powered on
Cash drawer counted and signed in
Grab a handheld (put another on to charge)
Power on lights and set to red
Turn on bar TVs/A-V and confirm music is playing
TVs on and set to current sports
Check all doors are unlocked (keys in kitchen)
Liquor, beer, and wine stock checked against par. Note any shortages
Garnish station prepped (citrus cut, glasses salted, dated)
Speed rail and back bar restocked
Bar mats, rails, and surfaces wiped down
Sanitizer buckets/wipes set up at bar stations
Check printer paper: Expo (impact) and Bar (thermal)
CO2 tank pressure and soda BIB levels checked. Low tank or any BIB under a quarter: note it for the Tuesday order
Margaritas batched to par for the night, labeled and dated
Phones away. No sitting or eating at the bar. Slow moment? Prep or restock
9 PM: top off all the ice before the 10 PM rush

bar_close.name: Bartender close
items: Batch / settle the Toast POS for the bar
Cash drawer counted, dropped, and reconciled
Tips recorded and distributed per policy
Last call announced at scheduled time
All tabs closed out. No open checks left in Toast
Guests cleared from bar; stools/chairs up
Garnishes wrapped, dated, and stored (or discarded per date)
Juices, mixers, and perishables sealed and stored in basement fridge
Speed rail and back bar restocked for next shift. Note shortages
Beer and wine restocked; flag any kegs that need changing
Empty bottles cleared; recycling taken out
CO2 tank pressure and soda BIB levels logged. Swap any empty BIB now so the next open starts full
Bar mats pulled, rinsed, and left to dry
All bar surfaces, sinks, and speed rails wiped and sanitized
Floor swept and mopped behind the bar
Under-bar coolers/reach-ins closed and confirmed running
Bar lights and TVs/A-V powered off
Final bar walkthrough: clean, stocked, secured
Margarita batch level noted so the opener knows how much to batch
